q: Angular momentum $L$ is defined as the product of moment of inertia $I$ and _____
e: Moment of inertia is Σ m r². It says how the mass is spread about the axis. Angular momentum L is defined as the product of moment of inertia I and angular velocity. Do not trade angular velocity for angular acceleration or torque.

q: The SI unit of angular momentum is _____
e: Circular motion uses angle, ω, and a centre-pointing acceleration v²/r. The SI unit of angular momentum is kg m² s⁻¹. N m or kg m s⁻¹ is a different relation from kg m² s⁻¹.
Circular motion uses angle, ω, and a centre-pointing acceleration v²/r. Angular momentum is a vector quantity. Do not trade vector for scalar or dimensionless.

q: The law of conservation of angular momentum states that if there is no net external torque, the total angular momentum of the system is _____
e: Torque is r × F, a cross product, so it is a vector. The law of conservation of angular momentum states that if there is no net external torque, the total angular momentum of the system is constant. Do not trade constant for zero or increasing.

q: An ice skater spinning with arms extended pulls her arms inward. Her moment of inertia decreases, so her angular speed _____
e: Moment of inertia is Σ m r². It says how the mass is spread about the axis. An ice skater spinning with arms extended pulls her arms inward. Her moment of inertia decreases, so her angular speed increases.

q: When a springboard diver rotates after jumping off the board, continued rotation occurs because _____
e: When a springboard diver rotates after jumping off the board, continued rotation occurs because angular momentum is conserved. Gravity provides torque or muscles keep working is not this quantity.

q: If the moment of inertia of a rotating object increases by a factor of 2 with no external torque, its angular speed becomes _____
e: Torque is r × F, a cross product, so it is a vector. If the moment of inertia of a rotating object increases by a factor of 2 with no external torque, its angular speed becomes half. Twice or unchanged is not this quantity.

q: The direction of angular momentum is the same as the direction of _____
e: Circular motion uses angle, ω, and a centre-pointing acceleration v²/r. The direction of angular momentum is the same as the direction of angular velocity. Linear velocity or centripetal force is not this quantity.

q: In symbols, the condition for conservation of angular momentum is _____
e: Circular motion uses angle, ω, and a centre-pointing acceleration v²/r. In symbols, the condition for conservation of angular momentum is sum tau = 0 Rightarrow L = constant. sum F = 0 Rightarrow L = constant or sum tau ≠ 0 Rightarrow L = constant is a different relation from sum tau = 0 Rightarrow L = constant.

q: To slow down her rotation, an ice skater should _____
e: To slow down her rotation, an ice skater should stretch arms outward. Do not trade stretch arms outward for pull arms inward or bend forward.
